hooks.command: if command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/bloquear-segredos.ps1"; elif command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/bloquear-segredos.ps1"; else sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run-hook.sh"; fi
